positions.title: Software Developer Engineer
positions.description:
Global Store CX Tech
Launched UK Global Store 2016  - https://www.amazon.co.uk/b?node=10859429031

Worked with most of the Retail Website platform teams (each its own page on their technology of choice) to deliver a Unified global store experience across amazon.com

Global Store enables customers to purchase products from other countries through their own local amazon marketplace.
